section: Hero: a sand panel with the title, standfirst, host and event details beside a large photograph
fields: Title (the page title at the top of the editor)
Insight box, below the title: Title highlight
Event details box: Date and Location
notes: Choose the Event format first, so the Event details box appears under the editor.
Title highlight is the part of the title shown in coral. Type it exactly as it appears in the title.
The sentence under the title is the Excerpt.
If a Host is chosen, the byline says "Hosted by" with that team member's photograph. If it is empty, the WordPress author is shown as "Written by".
On an event the date shown beside the topics is the event date, not the date the post was published, followed by the location.

section: Event details strip: date, location and the booking button
notes: The strip appears above the text as soon as one of the three fields is filled in.
The Book your place button opens the Booking link in a new tab. Leave the link empty to hide the button.
Use Heading 2 for each section, for example What to expect and Who it is for. They build the On this page list.

section: Sidebar: On this page and the timeline form
notes: There is nothing to fill in. The form is the same on every insight.

section: Related insights and the closing call to action
notes: Three other insights that share a Topic are shown automatically.
The dark "Interested in working with us?" band is a shared pattern.
